text:
maya (Product): Quick heads-up — I'm drafting the internal release notes and the short blurb for the internal announcement for the 0.9.2 rollout. Targeting Tue 09:00 PT release. Canary 10% for 30m -> ramp to 100% if green. Need sign-off on the blurb + pinning strategy.

sam (Eng Releases): SGTM. Can you paste the blurb and the version pins here so I can prod the announce copy?

maya (Product): pasted draft below. please keep edits inline.
```
Release 0.9.2 (internal) — rollout Tue 09:00 PT
- Performance: reduced p99 latency for short responses by ~18% (runtime kernel swap)
- Behavior: improved routing fallback to small-quantized variant for memory-heavy requests
- Ops: canary 10% for 30m, auto-rollforward if no errors; manual rollback playbook prepared
Migration/Pin: pin model to open-v2-2026-06-15 (sha: ab12c3) for hosted; Dedicated customers advised to pin to same hash to avoid auto-quant differences
Docs: feature flag `routing_fallback_v2` controls new behavior
```

alejandra (Docs): Nice. Two tiny suggestions: call out the model hash in the first bullet and add a one-liner migration step under Ops (how to pin via console). Also can we add a link to the rollback playbook? I'll add the short console snippet.

liam (SRE): Confirming SRE checks — canary window noted. Please ensure the deploy has the health-check gate on the /health/liveness endpoint and a :50% failure -> auto-abort threshold. Also please attach the exact rollback command and contact list.

nate (Platform): For Dedicated customers, we should recommend pinning via the API example (see snippet) — will add to docs. Also we should include the migration note about cache invalidation for KV cache after pinning.

maya (Product): Great. Adding the missing bits now. Propose final internal blurb for the announcement channel: "Heads-up: 0.9.2 rolling Tue 09:00 PT. Expected perf win for short responses. Canary 10%/30m. See internal RN + rollback playbook. Ops oncall: @liam." Thoughts?

sam (Eng Releases): That reads well. Can we add a short rollback sentence: "Rollback to 0.9.1 (sha: 9f8e7) available; see playbook" — then I'll pin in the announcement draft.

maya (Product): Done. Updated blurb: "Heads-up: 0.9.2 rolling Tue 09:00 PT. Expected perf win for short responses. Canary 10%/30m. Rollback to 0.9.1 (sha: 9f8e7) available; see playbook. Ops oncall: @liam."

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: 0.9.2 -> staging at 2026-06-17T16:00:00Z. Status: queued. (auto-post)
